diagnosed_issues.title: Artifacts Markdown Rendering and BiDi Direction Collapse
diagnosed_issues.root_cause: renderMarkdown lacks GFM table, GitHub alert callout, task list, and horizontal rule support; hardcoded dir='rtl' on artifact viewer dialog causes text scrambling; marked.umd.js is present in vendor/ but unlinked.
diagnosed_issues.remediation: Link vendor/marked.umd.js and vendor/purify.min.js in index.html, enhance renderMarkdown with full GFM tables, GitHub alerts, code block styling, and add Raw/Formatted view tabs with full copy and download buttons.

diagnosed_issues.title: Accessibility Tree Bloat and UI Thrashing with Screen Readers
diagnosed_issues.root_cause: Tool output details are set to open=true by default creating thousands of open DOM text nodes that freeze TalkBack/Jieshuo; scheduleAiRender thrashes DOM every 40ms; background sync polls aggressively every 3.5s.
diagnosed_issues.remediation: Collapse tool execution details by default (open=false) with accessible toggle summary; throttle live render to 120ms; apply CSS content-visibility:auto; implement smart background polling backoff.

execution_plan: 2. Link vendor libraries and improve artifact modal markup in server/web/index.html
3. Upgrade markdown rendering and optimize DOM/accessibility loops in server/web/main-ui.js
4. Add table, alert, and performance styles in server/web/main-ui.css
5. Sync updated web assets to app/src/main/assets/web/ and ~/.antigravity-server/web/
6. Run feature tests and validate with validate_code.py
